statement: This synthetic IMP/IMS is an evidence-calibrated experimental model created for the Predictive Program Management 2.0 capstone. It is not an actual or reconstructed F-35 contractor schedule.
note: Scenario definitions only. Every magnitude, policy value and effect is SYNTHETIC (an experimental assumption, not historically derived). Outcomes are NOT_COMPUTED: forward simulation is not yet implemented. Changes apply on top of base_scenario. DURATION_DELTA changes a synthetic duration; POLICY changes are parameters for the later deterministic simulator and never alter baseline predecessor logic.

scenarios.name: Synthetic planned baseline
scenarios.description: The frozen v1.0 network with no disturbance or intervention.

scenarios.name: Mission-system software integration late
scenarios.description: A210 Integrate Mission-System Software Components is projected to finish 8 workdays late.

scenarios.name: Test-aircraft configuration late
scenarios.description: A305 Modify / Configure Development Test Aircraft is projected to finish 4 workdays late.

scenarios.name: Software recovery action
scenarios.description: A software recovery action on A210 recovers 4 of the 8 late workdays.

scenarios.name: Flight-test resequencing after readiness
scenarios.description: A405 keeps all its predecessors; readiness is never bypassed. After A405 is satisfied, flight-test content that does not need the delayed mission-system capability is flown first while the affected content waits, absorbing up to 4 workdays of the delay that reaches the A410 flight-test block.

changes.intended_simulator_semantics: Let d = delay of A410's start versus baseline. A410 finish = baseline finish + max(0, d - delay_absorption_days). A405 and A410 start are unchanged by the policy; no predecessor is removed.

scenarios.name: Staged production commitment
scenarios.description: Concurrency is retained: A505 still starts without waiting for A430. Only 40% of the modeled long-lead commitment is made before A430 Development / Test Maturity; the remaining 60% is gated on A430. Compares full concurrent commitment with reduced pre-maturity exposure.

changes.intended_simulator_semantics: Exposure to rework found before A430 applies to pre_maturity_commitment_fraction of the A505 commitment; post_maturity_commitment_fraction is committed only once A430 finishes. No baseline predecessor is added. Rework and cost effects are not modeled yet.
